what: A big quote is rendered as a dot grid per line. At first a heap of dots magnified 14x covers the screen, and on scroll it shrinks to 1x by 1−(1−p)² while the dots light up from the right (jitter .1). Once progress passes .74, the real text is wiped in line by line with an edge slanted 18%, and the dots in front of it turn off. The description text floats up to .85 by the end.

options.power: Power of the shrinking curve, default 2
options.dot: Dot radius (share of a grid cell), default .2
options.dot-end: Progress at which all dots are lit, default .74
options.wipe: Progress at which the real text starts to be wiped clear, default .74
options.jitter: Jitter in the order dots light up, default .1
options.step: Dot grid cell (based on a 200px tall panel), default wide screen 3.8 · phone 6.4
options.trigger: Another element to measure progress against (css), if none, the part element

use:
Your quote here
Second line

Description
note: Put the dot plate (canvas) in so it fully covers the part element. If the element is a sticky pinned plate, attach it to that plate. Line elements must be inline-block so they can be measured
